task: Zero 2 W local connector and cable-end perception prerequisite
crop_basis: Fixed 896 x 448 pixel window centered on each optical axis, inspected in raw RGB; identical for every frame. No simulator or ground-truth object box used at inference.
backbone: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 frozen pretrained RGB encoder
decoder: DINO features fused with native RGB convolutional detail, predicting five visible-region masks
selection: maximum validation foreground macro IoU; one frozen checkpoint before held-out capture
limitations: Connector class is visible CAD housing/contact assembly, not an aperture or insertion target
Mini-end class is visible mini-end stiffener and contact pads; it is not a verified leading edge or grasp point
No latch state, insertion depth, 3D tip frame or calibrated uncertainty is produced
Fixed local camera windows require the task to be inside the observed region; this is not whole-desk cable discovery
Static synthetic data with uncalibrated optics and cable geometry; no real-image qualification
